title: refactor: streamline model management skill
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reduces the model-management skill from a 662-line monolith to a 119-line core workflow with four focused references.
- Records stable operating policy: provider preference, paid-only routing rules, no-fallback default, serverless/GPU criteria, and the 120-second media budget.
- Preserves the mandatory model-contract, E2E, billing, capacity, description, logo, and secret-safety gates.
- Keeps changing prices, balances, quotas, PR statuses, and candidate priorities in the ignored `temp` plans instead of hard-coding stale state.

Validation:

- `quick_validate.py .claude/skills/model-management`
- `git diff --check`
- Manual coverage audit of every existing mandatory gate

gist.headline: The model garden got pruned
gist.blurb: The model-management playbook is now a small core path with focused reference notes instead of one very determined 662-line scroll. The gates stayed; the stale weather reports moved out of the handbook.
gist.summary: Refactored the model-management skill from a 662-line monolith into a 119-line workflow plus four references, preserving model-contract, E2E, billing, capacity, description, logo, and secret-safety checks while moving volatile operational state into ignored temp plans.
gist.impact: Contributors get a clearer, maintainable process for model changes, with stable routing and testing policy separated from fast-changing prices, quotas, balances, and candidate status.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper with a tiny tool belt, pruning an oversized code-vine handbook into one neat central plant and four labeled reference seedlings. A cozy retro terminal can show simple checkmarks for the preserved validation gates, surrounded by flowers and organized paper notes.
